about: Trade conditions and pick protections that Sleeper cannot represent. Curated from #general rulings; loaded into The Oracle's prompt and shown on the picks page.

conditions.acquiredFrom: Title Chase (Aaron) in the three-team trade of Aug 31, 2026
conditions.rule: Protected against the 1.01. If Tim's 2027 first ends up as the 1.01, it is swapped for Ben's (Dirty Birds) 2027 first, which Title Chase owns.
requirements: Risky Business must keep possession of Tim's 2027 first until the 2027 draft order is set. Trading it away removes the protection.
If Title Chase trades Ben's 2027 first before the 2027 draft order is set, the protection is void and Tim's pick becomes an ordinary unprotected pick.
